source quality assurance before placement Download ExcelDownload PDF **18** Checkpoints **6** Sections Per bitumen lot/batch delivery; minimum once per project phase Testing Laboratory, QC Engineer [IS 73:1992](https://infralens.in/code/IS-73-2013) [IS 1203:1978](https://infralens.in/code/IS-1203-1978) [IS 1205:1978](https://infralens.in/code/IS-1205-1978) [IS 1208:1978](https://infralens.in/code/IS-1208-1978) Related [📐IS 73](https://infralens.in/code/IS-73) [✏️Concrete cover](https://infralens.in/thumbrules/concrete-cover-by-exposure) [📘Waterproofing Materials & M…](https://infralens.in/handbook/waterproofing-materials) [📖Min cover for RCC](https://infralens.in/knowledge/minimum-cover-rcc-is-456) [🔧water-demand-lpcd-calculator](https://infralens.in/tools/water-demand-lpcd-calculator) ### Checklist Preview Expand all ↓ | S.No. | Checkpoint | IS Requirement | Status | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | A. PENETRATION TEST (IS 1203) | | A1 | Penetration test conducted per IS 1203; 100g standard needle, 25°C, 5 sec loading
Acceptance: Test at 25°C ±0.5°C; 5 sec loading; needle 100g ±0.5g; result in 0.1mm units | Cl. 501 — Test procedure | | | A2 | Penetration value measured (0.1mm units); result documented
Acceptance: 60/70 grade: 60-70; 80/100: 80-100; 100/120: 100-120; 150/200: 150-200 (dmm) | Cl. 501 — Measurement recording | | | A3 | Three test specimens prepared and measured; average and standard deviation calculated
Acceptance: Three measurements; standard deviation <2 dmm; result = average of three | Cl. 501 — Statistical analysis | | | B. SOFTENING POINT TEST (IS 1205) | | B1 | Softening point test conducted per IS 1205 (Ring and Ball method); test at atmospheric pressure
Acceptance: Ring and ball apparatus; heating rate 5°C/min; end point when ball passes through ring | Cl. 501 — Test procedure | | | B2 | Softening point temperature recorded (°C); two test samples prepared
Acceptance: 60/70 grade: 46-56°C; 80/100: 47-57°C; measured at ±0.5°C precision | Cl. 501 — Temperature measurement | | | B3 | Average softening point calculated from two samples; result documented
Acceptance: Average of two tests; difference <2°C between samples; if >2°C, repeat test | Cl. 501 — Result calculation | | | C. DUCTILITY TEST (IS 1208) | | C1 | Ductility test conducted per IS 1208; briquette mold, constant extension rate 5 cm/min, 25°C
Acceptance: Test at 25°C; extension rate 5 cm/min; temperature maintained ±0.5°C | Cl. 501 — Test procedure | | | C2 | Ductility measured as elongation (cm) before thread breaks; result recorded
Acceptance: 60/70 & 80/100 grade: ≥75 cm at 25°C minimum; measured to 0.1cm precision | Cl. 501 — Measurement recording | | | C3 | Two specimens tested; elongation values recorded separately; result = lower value reported
Acceptance: Two samples minimum; report lower value; if <75 cm, batch rejected for poor ductility | Cl. 501 — Sample testing | | Showing 9 of 18 checkpoints ·View all → A.
